<script>
const isEuCountry = false;

let consentListenerAdded = false;

function loadAnalytics() {
  if (window.quant_cast_cookie && isEuCountry) {
    loadGA();
  }
}

function listenForConsent() {
  if (consentListenerAdded) return;
  consentListenerAdded = true;

  document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
    const target = event.target;
    const parent = target.parentElement;
    let eleClass = (target.className && typeof target.className === 'string')
      ? target.className.trim()
      : (parent && typeof parent.className === 'string' ? parent.className.trim() : '');

    if (eleClass === 'css-1jqk1n3') {
      setCookie('quant_cast_cookie', window.quant_cast_cookie, 30);
      loadAnalytics();
      return;
    }
    if (eleClass === 'css-1hy2vtq') {
      window.quant_cast_cookie = false;
      return;
    }
    if (target.innerText === 'REJECT ALL' || target.innerText === 'OFF') {
      window.quant_cast_cookie = false;
      setCookie('quant_cast_cookie', false, 30);
      return;
    }
    if (target.innerText === 'ACCEPT ALL' || target.innerText === 'ON') {
      window.quant_cast_cookie = true;
      setCookie('quant_cast_cookie', true, 30);
      loadAnalytics();
      return;
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      const popup = document.getElementById('qc-cmp2-container');
      if (popup) {
        window.quant_cast_cookie = false;
        setCookie('quant_cast_cookie', false, 30);
      }
    }
  });
}

window.addEventListener('load', function() {
  const gdprPopup = document.querySelector('#qc-cmp2-container');
  if (gdprPopup) {
    listenForConsent();
    return;
  }

  let checkCount = 0;
  const maxChecks = 5;
  const interval = setInterval(function() {
    const popup = document.getElementById('qc-cmp2-container');
    if (popup) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      listenForConsent();
      return;
    }
    checkCount++;
    if (checkCount >= maxChecks) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (!document.getElementById('qc-cmp2-container')) {
        setCookie('quant_cast_cookie', window.quant_cast_cookie, 30);
        loadAnalytics();
      }
    }
  }, 1000);
});

  const getLocaleReverse = {
    "": "en-US",
    "ar": "ar-AR",
    "de": "de-DE",
    "en": "en-US",
    "es": "es-ES",
    "fr": "fr-FR",
    "id": "id-ID",
    "it": "it-IT",
    "ja": "ja-JP",
    "ko": "ko-KR",
    "pl": "pl-PL",
    "pt-br": "pt-BR",
    "ru": "ru-RU",
    "th": "th-TH",
    "tr": "tr-TR",
    "vi": "vi-VN",
    "tw": "zh-TW"
  };
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const closeBtn = document.querySelector(".qr-close-modal");
    const popup = document.querySelector(".apk-download-popup");

    if (closeBtn && popup) {
      closeBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
        popup.style.display = "none";
      });
    }


    const emailInput = document.querySelector('.email-input-field');
    const sendButton = document.querySelector('.send-mail');
    const termsCheckbox = document.querySelector('.terms-div');
    const reSendMail = document.querySelector('.re-send-mail-container');
    const reSendMailLink = document.querySelector('.re-send-mail-resend-link');


    function validateEmail(email) {
      const re = /^(?:(?:[^<>()\[\]\\.,;:\s@"]+(?:\.[^<>()\[\]\\.,;:\s@"]+)*)|(".+"))@(?:(?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,})$/;
      return re.test(email);
    }

    function toggleSendButton() {
      const isValidEmail = validateEmail(emailInput.value.trim());
      sendButton.disabled = !isValidEmail;
    }
    let mailSent= false;

    function sendMail() {
      const email = emailInput.value.trim();
      if (!validateEmail(email)) return;

      let mobileApkLinkBase = "https://cloud.bluestacks.com";
      mobileApkLinkBase = location.host.includes('bluestacks.com') ? mobileApkLinkBase : "https://bs3-cloud-engg.bstkinternal.net";
      fetch(`${mobileApkLinkBase}/get_mobile_link`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            email: email,
            locale: getLocaleReverse["en"] || "en-US"
          })
        })
        .then(response => {
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
          return response.json();
        })
        .then(data => {
          sendButton.style.display = "none";
          termsCheckbox.style.display = "none";
          reSendMail.style.display = "flex";
          if(mailSent){
            const emailStatus = document.getElementById("email-status");
            const retryValue = emailStatus.getAttribute("data-retry");
            emailStatus.innerText = retryValue;
          }
          mailSent = true;
        })
        .catch(error => {
          console.error('Error sending email:', error);
          alert('Failed to send email.');
        });
    }

    emailInput.addEventListener('input', toggleSendButton);

    sendButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      window.sendAddExperimentData(
          'GetMobileAppLink',
          'HOME_PAGE',
          'en',
          'send_app_link',
          emailInput.value.trim(),
          '',
          '',
          'homepage-dl-button-en',
        );
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMail();
    });
    reSendMailLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      window.sendAddExperimentData(
          'GetMobileAppLink',
          'HOME_PAGE',
          'en',
          'resend_app_link',
          emailInput.value.trim(),
          '',
          '',
          'homepage-dl-button-en',
        );
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMail();
    });
  });

          raf = Math.abs(target.x - value.x) + Math.abs(target.y - value.y) > 0.001 ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : 0;
        };
        addEventListener(
          "pointermove",
          (e) => {
            target.x = (e.clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
            target.y = (e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 - 1;
            if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          },
          { passive: true },
        );
      }

      /* ───────────────────────── dot field (2D canvas) ───────────────────────── */
      // A jittered grid that waves gently and fades towards its edges; dots near the cursor are pushed away and spring back.
      const PALETTE = ["#2f5bff", "#3d55fb", "#4b4ff7", "#5949f3", "#6643f0", "#7240ee", "#7c3aed"];
      const PUSH_RADIUS = 120;
      const PUSH_DIST = 42;
      const colourAt = (t) => Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t)) * (PALETTE.length - 1));
      const makeDot = (x, y, s, a, t) => ({ hx: x, hy: y, x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, s, a, c: colourAt(t), ph: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });

      // The dots, hidden behind the screen, fading out in an ellipse around it. l = { w, h, sx, sy, sw, sh } (px).
      function field(l) {
        const g = l.w < 640 ? 9 : 10;
        const cx = l.sx + l.sw / 2;
        const cy = l.sy + l.sh / 2;
        const grid = [];
        for (let y = g / 2; y < l.h; y += g) {
          for (let x = g / 2; x < l.w; x += g) {
            const jx = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * g * 0.35;
            const jy = y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * g * 0.35;
            if (jx > l.sx + 4 && jx < l.sx + l.sw - 4 && jy > l.sy + 4 && jy < l.sy + l.sh - 4) continue;
            const e = ((jx - cx) / (0.52 * l.w)) ** 2 + ((jy - cy) / (0.56 * l.h)) ** 2;
            const a = 0.8 * (1 - e);
            if (a < 0.04) continue;
            grid.push(makeDot(jx, jy, 1.6, a * 0.85, jx / l.w));
          }
        }
        return grid;
      }

      function startField(canvas, getLayout, { interactive, animate }) {
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx) return;
        let layout = null;
        let buckets = [];
        let raf = 0;
        let visible = true;
        const pointer = { x: -1e4, y: -1e4 };

        const draw = (t) => {
          if (!layout) return;
          const box = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
          const scale = box.width / layout.w || 1; // the canvas may be scaled by a parent transform
          const px = (pointer.x - box.left) / scale;
          const py = (pointer.y - box.top) / scale;
          const step = (d, homeX, homeY) => {
            let tx = homeX;
            let ty = homeY;
            const dx = d.x - px;
            const dy = d.y - py;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            if (dist < PUSH_RADIUS && dist > 0.01) {
              const f = (1 - dist / PUSH_RADIUS) ** 2 * PUSH_DIST;
              tx += (dx / dist) * f;
              ty += (dy / dist) * f;
            }
            d.vx = (d.vx + (tx - d.x) * 0.09) * 0.78;
            d.vy = (d.vy + (ty - d.y) * 0.09) * 0.78;
            d.x += d.vx;
            d.y += d.vy;
            ctx.globalAlpha = d.a;
            ctx.fillRect(d.x - d.s / 2, d.y - d.s / 2, d.s, d.s);
          };
          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          for (let b = 0; b < buckets.length; b++) {
            ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE[b];
            for (const d of buckets[b]) step(d, d.hx, animate ? d.hy + Math.sin(t * 0.0012 + d.hx * 0.018 + d.ph * 0.3) * 1.6 : d.hy);
          }
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        };

        const build = () => {
          const l = getLayout();
          if (l.sw < 2) return;
          const dpr = Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
          canvas.width = Math.round(l.w * dpr);
          canvas.height = Math.round(l.h * dpr);
          ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
          layout = l;
          const grid = field(l);
          buckets = PALETTE.map((_, i) => grid.filter((d) => d.c === i));
          draw(performance.now());
        };
        const loop = (t) => {
          draw(t);
          raf = visible ? requestAnimationFrame(loop) : 0;
        };

        build();
        new ResizeObserver(build).observe(canvas);
        new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
          visible = entry.isIntersecting;
          if (visible && animate && !raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }).observe(canvas);
        if (interactive) {
          addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => { pointer.x = e.clientX; pointer.y = e.clientY; }, { passive: true });
          document.documentElement.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { pointer.x = pointer.y = -1e4; });
        }
        if (animate) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }

      /* ───────────────────────── WebGL glow around the screen ───────────────────────── */
      // Tweak the glow here.
      const GLOW = {
        spread: 70, // px the glow extends beyond the container
        radius: 12, // container corner radius (matches rounded-xl)
        secondsPerTurn: 12, // one clockwise rotation
        maxFps: 30,
        colors: ["#0a6cff", "#a020f0", "#c4aaff"], // blue → purple, lavender highlight
        saturation: 0.7, // 1 = full colour, 0 = grey
        rimOpacity: 0.35, // crisp border line along the container edge
      };
      const VERT = `attribute vec2 aPos; void main() { gl_Position = vec4(aPos, 0.0, 1.0); }`;
      const FRAG = `
      precision highp float;
      uniform vec2 uRes;
      uniform vec2 uHalf;
      uniform float uRadius;
      uniform float uSpread;
      uniform float uTime;
      uniform float uRot;
      uniform vec3 uColA;
      uniform vec3 uColB;
      uniform vec3 uColC;
      uniform float uSat;
      uniform float uRim;

      float hash(vec2 p) { return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453); }
      float noise(vec2 p) {
        vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p);
        vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
        return mix(mix(hash(i), hash(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x),
                  mix(hash(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x), u.y);
      }
      float fbm(vec2 p) {
        float v = 0.0, a = 0.5;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { v += a * noise(p); p *= 2.03; a *= 0.5; }
        return v;
      }
      float sdRoundBox(vec2 p, vec2 b, float r) {
        vec2 q = abs(p) - b + r;
        return length(max(q, 0.0)) + min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.0) - r;
      }

      void main() {
        vec2 p = gl_FragCoord.xy - uRes * 0.5;
        float d = sdRoundBox(p, uHalf, uRadius);
        if (d < -3.0) { gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0); return; } // hidden behind the screen

        vec2 q = p / max(uHalf.x, uHalf.y);
        float t = uTime;

        // Liquid motion: domain-warped noise drifting over time.
        vec2 w = vec2(fbm(q * 2.0 + vec2(t * 0.10, -t * 0.07)),
                      fbm(q * 2.0 + vec2(-t * 0.08, t * 0.11) + 5.2));
        float n = fbm(q * 3.0 + w * 1.6 + t * 0.05);

        // Adding time to the angle turns the pattern clockwise in GL's y-up space.
        float a = atan(p.y, p.x) + t * uRot + (n - 0.5) * 2.2;
        float s = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(a);
        vec3 col = mix(uColA, uColB, s);
        col = mix(col, uColC, smoothstep(0.65, 1.0, n) * 0.6);
        col = mix(vec3(dot(col, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114))), col, uSat);

        float band = 0.45 + 0.55 * pow(0.5 + 0.5 * cos(a - 1.2), 2.0);

        // Uneven thickness: two rotating blooms (cos 2θ) that slowly breathe, roughened by the noise.
        float a0 = atan(p.y, p.x) + t * uRot;
        float lobes = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * cos(2.0 * a0 + 0.9 * sin(t * 0.3)), 3.2);
        float thick = clamp(0.22 + 1.05 * lobes + (n - 0.5) * 0.6, 0.15, 1.3);

        // Soft exponential tail blended with a defined body, tapered to exactly zero at the canvas edge.
        float dd = max(d, 0.0);
        float body = pow(clamp(1.0 - dd / (uSpread * 0.85 * thick), 0.0, 1.0), 1.8);
        float falloff = mix(exp(-dd / (uSpread * 0.22 * thick)), body, 0.6);
        vec2 edge = uRes * 0.5 - abs(p);
        float edgeFade = smoothstep(0.0, uSpread * 0.55, min(edge.x, edge.y));
        float glow = falloff * edgeFade * band * mix(0.5, 1.0, thick) * (0.7 + 0.6 * n);
        float rim = smoothstep(1.6, 0.0, abs(d)) * uRim * (0.5 + 0.5 * band);
        float alpha = clamp(glow * 0.75 + rim, 0.0, 1.0);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(col * alpha, alpha);
      }`;

      const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
        const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
        return [((n >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255, (n & 255) / 255];
      };

      function initGlow(canvas, wrap, onReady, onFail, onLost) {
        const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl", { alpha: true, antialias: false, premultipliedAlpha: true, powerPreference: "low-power" });
        if (!gl) return onFail(), () => { };
        const compile = (type, src) => {
          const sh = gl.createShader(type);
          gl.shaderSource(sh, src);
          gl.compileShader(sh);
          return gl.getShaderParameter(sh, gl.COMPILE_STATUS) ? sh : null;
        };
        const vs = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, VERT);
        const fs = compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, FRAG);
        const prog = gl.createProgram();
        if (vs && fs) {
          gl.attachShader(prog, vs);
          gl.attachShader(prog, fs);
          gl.linkProgram(prog);
        }
        if (!vs || !fs || !gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) return onFail(), () => { };
        gl.useProgram(prog);

        // One oversized triangle covers the whole canvas.
        gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, gl.createBuffer());
        gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1, -1, 3, -1, -1, 3]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
        const aPos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, "aPos");
        gl.enableVertexAttribArray(aPos);
        gl.vertexAttribPointer(aPos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);

        const u = (name) => gl.getUniformLocation(prog, name);
        const uTime = u("uTime");
        gl.uniform1f(u("uRot"), (Math.PI * 2) / GLOW.secondsPerTurn);
        gl.uniform3fv(u("uColA"), hexToRgb(GLOW.colors[0]));
        gl.uniform3fv(u("uColB"), hexToRgb(GLOW.colors[1]));
        gl.uniform3fv(u("uColC"), hexToRgb(GLOW.colors[2]));
        gl.uniform1f(u("uSat"), GLOW.saturation);
        gl.uniform1f(u("uRim"), GLOW.rimOpacity);

        const scale = Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1, 2) * 0.65; // a soft glow doesn't need full resolution
        const start = performance.now();
        let raf = 0;
        let last = 0;
        let readySent = false;

        const draw = (t) => {
          gl.uniform1f(uTime, t);
          gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
          if (!readySent) {
            readySent = true;
            onReady();
          }
        };
        const resize = () => {
          const { width, height } = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
          canvas.width = Math.round((width + GLOW.spread * 2) * scale);
          canvas.height = Math.round((height + GLOW.spread * 2) * scale);
          gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          gl.uniform2f(u("uRes"), canvas.width, canvas.height);
          gl.uniform2f(u("uHalf"), (width / 2) * scale, (height / 2) * scale);
          gl.uniform1f(u("uRadius"), GLOW.radius * scale);
          gl.uniform1f(u("uSpread"), GLOW.spread * scale);
          draw(reduced ? 4 : (performance.now() - start) / 1000);
        };
        const frame = (now) => {
          raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          if (now - last < 1000 / GLOW.maxFps) return;
          last = now;
          draw((now - start) / 1000);
        };

        const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
        ro.observe(wrap);

        // Browsers may drop WebGL contexts of background tabs: hand back so the caller restarts on a fresh canvas.
        const handleLost = (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
          raf = 0;
          onLost();
        };
        canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", handleLost);
        const checkAlive = () => {
          if (document.visibilityState === "visible" && gl.isContextLost()) onLost();
        };
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", checkAlive);

        // Only animate while on screen.
        const io = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) checkAlive();
          if (reduced) return;
          if (entry.isIntersecting && !raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          if (!entry.isIntersecting && raf) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
            raf = 0;
          }
        });
        io.observe(wrap);

        return () => {
          cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
          ro.disconnect();
          io.disconnect();
          document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", checkAlive);
          canvas.removeEventListener("webglcontextlost", handleLost); // detach first, or our own loseContext() restarts it
          gl.getExtension("WEBGL_lose_context")?.loseContext();
        };
      }

      // Wraps `children` (an element) in the glow. Returns the wrapper element.
      function glowFrame(child) {
        const wrap = el(`<div class="bsv-glow"><div class="bsv-glow__slot" data-slot></div></div>`);
        wrap.querySelector("[data-slot]").appendChild(child);
        let canvas = null;
        let cleanup = () => { };
        const mountCanvas = () => {
          canvas?.remove();
          canvas = el(
            `<canvas aria-hidden="true" class="bsv-glow__canvas" style="top:${-GLOW.spread}px;left:${-GLOW.spread}px;width:calc(100% + ${GLOW.spread * 2}px);height:calc(100% + ${GLOW.spread * 2}px)"></canvas>`,

            mine,
            wrap,
            () => { mine.classList.add("bsv-glow__canvas--ready"); },
            () => { // no WebGL: a blurred gradient instead
              mine.remove();
              wrap.insertBefore(el(`<div aria-hidden="true" class="bsv-glow__fallback" style="background:var(--gradient-accent)"></div>`), wrap.firstChild);
            },
            () => { cleanup(); mountCanvas(); },
          );
        };

        if ("requestIdleCallback" in window) requestIdleCallback(mountCanvas, { timeout: 1500 });
        else setTimeout(mountCanvas, 300);
        return wrap;
      }

      /* ───────────────────────── taskbar ───────────────────────── */
      const dockLogo = (src) => img(src, "", "bsv-dock__logo", { w: 24, h: 24 });

      // Google Play logo, inline (the /logos/play-store.svg asset does not exist on the CDN, so it 404ed).
      const PLAY_ICON = `<svg viewBox="0 0 28.99 31.99" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g data-name="Capa 2"><g data-name="Capa 1"><path d="M13.54 15.28.12 29.34a3.66 3.66 0 0 0 5.33 2.16l15.1-8.6Z" style="fill:#ea4335"/><path d="m27.11 12.89-6.530-3.74-7.35 6.45 7.38 7.28 6.48-3.7a3.54 3.54 0 0 0 1.5-4.79 3.620 3.620 0 0 0-1.5-1.5z" style="fill:#fbbc04"/><path d="M.12 2.66a3.57 3.57 0 0 0-.12.92v24.84a3.57 3.57 0 0 0 .12.92L14 15.64Z" style="fill:#4285f4"/><path d="m13.64 16 6.94-6.85L5.5.51A3.73 3.73 0 0 0 3.63 0 3.64 3.64 0 0 0 .12 2.65Z" style="fill:#34a853"/></g></g></svg>`;

      // Taskbar centre of bst-view.jpg (bar spans the bottom 6.7%): app-grid button, divider, pinned apps, then `extra`.
      function dock(extra) {
        const base = [
          { id: "play", icon: PLAY_ICON },
          { id: "chrome", icon: `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" viewBox="0 0 48 48" height="48" width="48"><defs><linearGradient id="a" x1="3.2173" y1="15" x2="44.7812" y2="15" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#d93025"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ea4335"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="b" x1="20.7219" y1="47.6791" x2="41.5039" y2="11.6837" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fcc934"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#fbbc04"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="c" x1="26.5981" y1="46.5015" x2="5.8161" y2="10.506" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#1e8e3e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#34a853"/></linearGradient></defs><circle cx="24" cy="23.9947" r="12" style="fill:#fff"/><path d="M3.2154,36A24,24,0,1,0,12,3.2154,24,24,0,0,0,3.2154,36ZM34.3923,18A12,12,0,1,1,18,13.6077,12,12,0,0,1,34.3923,18Z" style="fill:none"/><path d="M24,12H44.7812a23.9939,23.9939,0,0,0-41.5639.0029L13.6079,30l.0093-.0024A11.9852,11.9852,0,0,1,24,12Z" style="fill:url(#a)"/><circle cx="24" cy="24" r="9.5" style="fill:#1a73e8"/><path d="M34.3913,30.0029,24.0007,48A23.994,23.994,0,0,0,44.78,12.0031H23.9989l-.0025.0093A11.985,11.985,0,0,1,34.3913,30.0029Z" style="fill:url(#b)"/><path d="M13.6086,30.0031,3.218,12.006A23.994,23.994,0,0,0,24.0025,48L34.3931,30.0029l-.0067-.0068a11.9852,11.9852,0,0,1-20.7778.007Z" style="fill:url(#c)"/></svg>` },
          { id: "play-games", icon: `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xml:space="preserve" viewBox="0 0 478.633 534.478"><path fill="#1A8039" d="M0 475.22V59.229C0 13.727 49.285-14.776 88.774 8.027l360.28 207.969c39.438 22.803 39.438 79.705 0 102.456L88.774 526.473C49.336 549.224 0 520.773 0 475.22z"/><path fill="#94FED6" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M257.98 236.208c-7.981-46.486-48.3-80.275-95.46-80.275H0v222.584h115.567l84.007 84.007 89.034-51.409-30.628-174.907zm-142.62-50.166c15.34 0 27.829 12.49 27.829 27.985 0 15.34-12.49 27.829-27.829 27.829-15.495 0-27.985-12.49-27.985-27.829 0-15.495 12.49-27.985 27.985-27.985zM62.085 295.183c-15.34 0-27.829-12.49-27.829-27.985 0-15.34 12.49-27.829 27.829-27.829 15.495 0 27.985 12.49 27.985 27.829 0 15.496-12.49 27.985-27.985 27.985zm53.275 53.12c-15.495 0-27.985-12.334-27.985-27.829 0-15.34 12.49-27.829 27.985-27.829 15.34 0 27.829 12.49 27.829 27.829.001 15.495-12.489 27.829-27.829 27.829zm53.845-53.12c-15.495 0-27.985-12.49-27.985-27.985 0-15.34 12.49-27.829 27.985-27.829 15.34 0 27.829 12.49 27.829 27.829-.051 15.496-12.541 27.985-27.829 27.985z" clip-rule="evenodd"/></svg>` },
        ];
      const root = el(`<div aria-hidden="true" class="bsv-dock">

        const items = {};
        for (const app of [...base, ...extra]) {

        <span data-ul class="bsv-dock__underline"></span>

      /* ───────────────────────── app windows ("the video") ───────────────────────── */
      // One app works at a time: its window comes to the front, plays its task (taps only), then the next app takes over.
      // All sizes are cqw of the screen. Each window's content area has a fixed aspect ratio, so tap targets (% of the
      // content area) land on the same spot at every size. An app is { root, set(step) }: set() shows step N of its task.

      const APPS = {
        social: { title: w.social.app, tint: "#111", icon: icon("Activity", "bsv-app-icon", 2.6) },
        play: { title: w.play.app, tint: "#fff", icon: PLAY_ICON.replace("<svg ", '<svg class="bsv-app-icon bsv-app-icon--lg" width="16" height="16" ') },
        food: { title: w.food.app, tint: "#ef4f2f", icon: icon("UtensilsCrossed", "bsv-app-icon", 2.4) },
        chat: { title: w.chat.app, tint: "#2f5bff", icon: icon("MessageCircle", "bsv-app-icon", 2.4) },
      };
      const ORDER = ["social", "play", "food", "chat"]; // cascade order (back to front) and the order apps take turns

      function appWindow(app, ratio, at, content) {
        const { title, tint, icon: ic } = APPS[app];
        const node = el(`<div class="bsv-window bsv-window--${app} v2-pop" style="--d:${at}s">

        </div>
        <div data-body class="bsv-window__body" style="aspect-ratio:${ratio}"></div>
      </div>
    </div>`);
        node.querySelector("[data-body]").appendChild(content);
        const win = node.querySelector("[data-win]");
        const bar = node.querySelector("[data-bar]");
        const setOn = (on) => {
          win.classList.toggle("bsv-window__frame--active", on);
          bar.classList.toggle("bsv-window__bar--active", on);
        };
        return { node, setOn };

      // A tap: a ripple where the tap that started the current step landed. targets[i] is the tap that starts step i + 1.
      function setTap(root, step, targets) {
        root.querySelector("[data-tap]")?.remove();

      // A tap point for a window laid out in cqw: converts a point in cqw to % of a W×H content area.
      const at = (W, H) => (x, y, hover) => ({ x: (x / W) * 100, y: (y / H) * 100, hover });

      const avatar = (name, color, cls) =>
        `<span class="bsv-avatar ${cls}" style="background:${color}">${esc(

      const FOOD_MS = [1300, 2000, 1500, 1400, 1300, 2700];
      const FOOD = { head: 8.4, top: 0.8, pitch: 13.5, add: { x: 17, y: 11.2 } }; // card top, spacing, Add button centre (cqw)
      const fpt = at(21, 34);

      function Food() {
        const f = w.food;
        const pickTop = FOOD.top + f.pick * FOOD.pitch;
        const targets = [fpt(10.5, 23, true), fpt(10.5, 16, true), fpt(FOOD.add.x, FOOD.head + 1 + FOOD.add.y), fpt(10.5, 31.5), null, null];
        const root = el(`<div class="bsv-food">
      <div class="bsv-food__header">

          ${icon("MapPin", "bsv-food__pin", 2.4)}

              <p class="bsv-food__name">${esc(d.name)}</p>

              <div class="bsv-food__row">
                <span class="bsv-food__price">${esc(d.price)}</span>

              <span class="bsv-food__placed-badge">${icon("Check", "bsv-food__done-icon", 3)}</span>
              <p class="bsv-food__placed-title">${esc(f.placed)}</p>

      /* ── Chat: an inbox with unread threads; the agent opens each one, types a reply and sends it, then goes back (19×33 cqw) ── */
      const CHAT_MS = [1500, 1200, 1800, 1100, 1400, 1200, 1800, 1100, 2400];
      const cpt = at(19, 33);
      const ROW = (i) => 4.4 + 2.4 + i * 4.8; // thread row centre (cqw)
      const unreadIdx = w.chat.threads.flatMap((t, i) => (t.reply ? [i] : []));

      function Chat() {
        const [a, b] = unreadIdx;
        const input = cpt(7.5, 30.6);
        const send = cpt(16.5, 30.6);
        const back = cpt(1.4, 1.9);
        const targets = [cpt(9.5, ROW(a)), input, send, back, cpt(9.5, ROW(b)), input, send, back, null];
        const root = el(`<div class="bsv-chat"></div>`);
        let view = null;
        let viewKey = "";

        const listView = (step) => {
          const answered = (i) => (i === a && step >= 3) || (i === b && step >= 7);
          return el(`<div class="bsv-chat__list v2-in" style="--d:0s">
        <div class="bsv-chat__search">${icon("Search", "bsv-search-icon", 2.4)}${esc(w.chat.search)}</div>
        <div class="bsv-chat__threads">
          ${w.chat.threads
              .map((t, i) => {
                const unread = !!t.reply && !answered(i);
                const preview = t.reply ? (answered(i) ? `You: ${t.reply}` : t.incoming[t.incoming.length - 1]) : t.preview;
                return `<div class="bsv-chat__row">
              ${avatar(t.name, t.color, "bsv-avatar--lg")}
              <span class="bsv-chat__row-body">
                <span class="bsv-chat__row-top">
                  <span class="bsv-chat__name${unread ? " bsv-chat__name--unread" : ""}">${esc(t.name)}</span>
                  <span class="bsv-chat__time${unread ? " bsv-chat__time--unread" : ""}">${esc(t.time)}</span>
                </span>
                <span class="bsv-chat__row-bottom">
                  <span class="bsv-chat__preview${unread ? " bsv-chat__preview--unread" : ""}">${esc(preview)}</span>

        };
        const threadView = (thread) =>
          el(`<div class="bsv-chat__thread v2-slide">
        <div class="bsv-chat__thread-header">
          ${icon("ChevronLeft", "bsv-chat__back", 2.4)}${avatar(thread.name, thread.color, "bsv-avatar--md")}
          <span class="bsv-chat__thread-name">${esc(thread.name)}</span>
        </div>

        </div>
        <div class="bsv-chat__input-bar">
          <span data-input class="bsv-chat__input"></span>
          <span class="bsv-chat__send">${icon("SendHorizontal", "bsv-chat__send-icon", 2.4)}</span>
        </div>

        return {
          root,
          still: 8,
          set(step) {

            const open = step >= 1 && step <= 3 ? a : step >= 5 && step <= 7 ? b : null;

            if (key !== viewKey) {

            if (open !== null) {
              const thread = w.chat.threads[open];
              const msgs = view.querySelector("[data-msgs]");

              } else if (phase !== 2 && sent) sent.remove();
              const inputEl = view.querySelector("[data-input]");
              if (inputEl.dataset.phase !== String(phase)) {
                inputEl.dataset.phase = String(phase);
                inputEl.innerHTML =
                  phase === 1
                    ? `<span class="bsv-chat__typed v2-type" style="--d:0.3s">${esc(thread.reply)}</span>`
                    : `<span class="bsv-chat__placeholder">${esc(w.chat.input)}</span>`;
              }

      /* ── Google Play (live screenshot): open an app from the home page, install it, then Open ── */
      const PLAY_MS = [1500, 1500, 2300, 2600];
      const ICON_PT = { x: 12.2, y: 40.4 }; // Focus Friend's icon in play-store.jpg

      function Play() {

        let sheet = null; // the dim layer + install sheet, shown from step 1
        let btn = null;

          step === 2
            ? `<span class="bsv-play__progress-bg"></span>
           <span class="bsv-play__progress-fill v2-fill" style="--d:0.1s"></span>

      /* ── Pulse (X-style social app, landscape): scroll the feed, like a post, scroll back up, write a post and publish it ──

      function Social() {

        const targets = [spt(15, 14, true), heart, spt(15, 10, true), spt(12, S.head + 2), spt(23.4, S.head + 3.9), null];

        const root = el(`<div class="bsv-social">
      <div class="bsv-social__rail">

            .map((tab, i) => `<span class="bsv-social__tab${i === 0 ? " bsv-social__tab--active" : ""}">${esc(tab)}${i === 0 ? '<span class="bsv-social__tab-line"></span>' : ""}</span>`)
            .join("")}
        </div>
        <div data-feed class="bsv-social__feed" style="transition-duration:0.8s">
          <div class="bsv-social__composer">
            <span class="bsv-social__me">Y</span>
            <span data-compose class="bsv-social__compose"></span>
            <span data-post class="bsv-social__post-btn">${esc(sc.post)}</span>
          </div>
          ${sc.posts
            .map((p, i) => {
              const { top, h } = postBox(i);
              return `<div data-p class="bsv-social__post" style="top:${top}cqw;height:${h}cqw">
              ${img(p.avatar, "", "bsv-social__post-avatar", { w: 40, h: 40 })}
              <div class="bsv-social__post-body">

        <div class="bsv-social__search">${icon("Search", "bsv-search-icon bsv-search-icon--sm", 2.4)}${esc(sc.search)}</div>
        <div class="bsv-social__trends">
          <p class="bsv-social__trends-title">${esc(sc.trendsTitle)}</p>
          ${sc.trends.map((t) => `<div class="bsv-social__trend"><p class="bsv-social__trend-topic">${esc(t.topic)}</p><p class="bsv-social__trend-count">${esc(t.count)}</p></div>`).join("")}

        const feed = root.querySelector("[data-feed]");
        const compose = root.querySelector("[data-compose]");
        const postBtn = root.querySelector("[data-post]");

          still: 2,

                ? `<span class="bsv-social__typed v2-type" style="--d:0.2s">${esc(sc.draft)}</span>`
                : `<span class="bsv-social__muted">${esc(sc.compose)}</span>`;

            const liked = step >= 2;
            if (liked !== wasLiked) {

              likeEl.classList.toggle("bsv-social__stat--liked", liked);

            posts.forEach((p) => (p.style.transform = posted ? "translateY(6.4cqw)" : ""));
            if (posted && !youPost) {

            <span class="bsv-social__me">Y</span>
            <div class="bsv-social__post-body">
              <p class="bsv-social__post-head"><span class="bsv-social__post-name">${esc(sc.you.name)}</span> <span class="bsv-social__muted">${esc(sc.you.handle)} · now</span></p>

            </div>

          },

      }

      /* ── The turn-taking: which app is active, its z-order, and the timers that step its task ── */
      function multiWindow() {
        const apps = { social: Social(), play: Play(), food: Food(), chat: Chat() };
        const wins = {
          social: appWindow("social", "16/10", 0.1, apps.social.root),
          play: appWindow("play", "16/10", 0.2, apps.play.root),
          food: appWindow("food", "21/34", 0.35, apps.food.root),
          chat: appWindow("chat", "19/33", 0.5, apps.chat.root),

        );
        root.appendChild(taskbar.root);

        let stack = [...ORDER]; // back to front
        const layer = () => stack.forEach((id, i) => (wins[id].node.style.zIndex = i + 1));
        const show = (active) => {
          for (const id of ORDER) wins[id].setOn(id === active);
          taskbar.setActive(active);
        };
        for (const id of ORDER) apps[id].set(0);
        layer();

        if (reduced) {
          // No motion: each window holds one representative step, Google Play shown as active.
          for (const id of ORDER) apps[id].set(apps[id].still);
          show("play");
          return root;
        }

        const MS = { social: SOCIAL_MS, play: PLAY_MS, food: FOOD_MS, chat: CHAT_MS };
        let current = ORDER[0];
        const takeTurn = (id) => {
          current = id;
          stack = [...stack.filter((a) => a !== id), id];
          layer();
          show(id);
          apps[id].set(0); // a new turn starts its task from step 0
          const durations = MS[id];
          let i = 0;
          setTimeout(function tick() {
            i += 1;
            if (i >= durations.length) return takeTurn(ORDER[(ORDER.indexOf(id) + 1) % ORDER.length]); // hand over
            apps[id].set(i);
            setTimeout(tick, durations[i]);
          }, durations[0]);
        };
        takeTurn(current);
        return root;
      }

      /* ───────────────────────── the stage ───────────────────────── */
      // A big BlueStacks screen with app windows cascading in it, over an open dot field that spills past the stage. The
      // screen and the dots drift apart slightly with the cursor (parallax), for depth.
      const BLEED = 120;
      function mount(host) {
        ASSETS = host.dataset.assets ? (host.dataset.assets.endsWith("/") ? host.dataset.assets : host.dataset.assets + "/") : ASSETS;
        const screenInner = el(`<div class="bsv-screen v2-screen">${img("/bs-home/v2/bst-view.jpg", "BlueStacks Desktop running on Android 16", "bsv-cover", { fill: true, priority: true })}</div>`);
        screenInner.appendChild(multiWindow());

        const stage = el(`<div class="bsv-stage">
      <div class="bsv-stage__dots" style="transform:${depth(-10)}">
        <canvas aria-hidden="true" class="bsv-stage__canvas v2-fade-in" style="inset:${-BLEED}px;width:calc(100% + ${2 * BLEED}px);height:calc(100% + ${2 * BLEED}px)"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div data-screen class="bsv-stage__screen">
        <div data-glow class="bsv-stage__depth" style="transform:${depth(8)}"></div>
      </div>
    </div>`);
        stage.querySelector("[data-glow]").appendChild(glowFrame(screenInner));
        host.appendChild(stage);

        const screen = stage.querySelector("[data-screen]");
        parallax(stage);
        // offset* ignore the parallax transforms, so the field lines up with the screen at rest.
        startField(
          stage.querySelector("canvas"),
          () => ({
            w: stage.clientWidth + 2 * BLEED,
            h: stage.clientHeight + 2 * BLEED,
            sx: screen.offsetLeft + BLEED,
            sy: screen.offsetTop + BLEED,
            sw: screen.offsetWidth,
            sh: screen.offsetHeight,
          }),
          { interactive: finePointer, animate: !reduced },
        );
      }

      const start = () => document.querySelectorAll("[data-bluestacks-visual]").forEach(mount);
      if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", start);
      else start();
      window.BluestacksVisual = { mount };
    })();
  </script>

(function () {

    clearTimeout(readyTimer);
    if (on && ['ru', 'vi'].includes(section.dataset.locale)) {
      readyTimer = setTimeout(() => { section.dataset.devReady = 'true'; }, reduceMotion ? 0 : 1000);
    } else {
      section.dataset.devReady = 'false';
    }
  };

  const track = (userAction, attr1, attr2) => {
    if (typeof sendAddExperimentData !== 'function') return;
    const locale = location.pathname.split('/')[1];
    sendAddExperimentData('HomepageAndroidDesktopHero', 'HOME_PAGE', locale, userAction, attr1, attr2);
  };

  const schedule = (on, delay = 120) => {
    if (on === isOpen()) { clearTimeout(timer); pending = null; return; }
    if (pending === on) return;
    clearTimeout(timer);
    pending = on;
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      pending = null;
      if (on) track('desktop_section_open', '');
      setDev(on);
    }, delay);
  };

  // Same maths as the CSS: --at = 60% closed / 33% open, --s = min(300px, 21vw)
  const isRtl = section.dataset.rtl === 'true';
  const isOverDev = (e) => {
    const r = section.getBoundingClientRect();
    const at = (isOpen() ? 0.33 : 0.6) * r.width;
    const s = Math.min(300, window.innerWidth * 0.21);
    const y = Math.min(Math.max((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height, 0), 1);
    const lineX = at + s * (1 - 2 * y);   // top: at + s, bottom: at - s
    const x = e.clientX - r.left;
    return isRtl ? x < r.width - lineX : x > lineX;   // RTL: right panel is mirrored to the left
  };

  // Right of the line → open, left of the line → close
  section.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || !isDesktop()) return;
    schedule(isOverDev(e));
  });

  // Mouse leaves the hero → close
  section.addEventListener('pointerleave', (e) => {
    if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;
    schedule(false, 250);
  });

  // Touch: tap right side to open, tap the dark left side to close
  dev.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!isOpen() && !e.target.closest('a')) setDev(true);
  });
  if (dim) dim.addEventListener('click', () => setDev(false));

  const knowMore = dev.querySelector('.know-more-link');
  if (knowMore) {
    knowMore.addEventListener('click', () => track('know_more_btn_click', '', knowMore.getAttribute('href')));
  }

  // Keyboard: tabbing into a side opens it
  if (gamer) gamer.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => { if (e.target.matches(':focus-visible')) setDev(false); });
  dev.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => { if (e.target.matches(':focus-visible')) setDev(true); });

  /* ---------- Tag labels: shrink long text so it stays inside the tag shape ---------- */
  // Max text width as a share of --s (min(300px, 21vw)): the Gamers tag is narrower where its text sits.
  const TAG_FIT = { gamers: .27, agents: .34 };
  const fitTags = () => {
    if (!isDesktop()) return;
    const s = Math.min(300, window.innerWidth * 0.21);
    Object.keys(TAG_FIT).forEach((key) => {
      const max = s * TAG_FIT[key];
      section.querySelectorAll('.bs-tag--' + key + ' .bs-tag-for, .bs-tag--' + key + ' .bs-tag-name').forEach((el) => {
        el.style.fontSize = '';                       // back to the stylesheet size
        const base = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize);
        const width = el.scrollWidth;
        if (width > max) el.style.fontSize = Math.max(9, base * max / width) + 'px';
      });
    });
  };
  fitTags();
  window.addEventListener('resize', fitTags);
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(fitTags);

  /* ---------- Mockup parallax ---------- */
  const stage = section.querySelector('.bs-stage');
  if (stage && !reduceMotion && window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches) {
    const target = { x: 0, y: 0 }, cur = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    let praf = 0;
    const tick = () => {
      cur.x += (target.x - cur.x) * .07;
      cur.y += (target.y - cur.y) * .07;
      stage.style.setProperty('--px', cur.x.toFixed(4));
      stage.style.setProperty('--py', cur.y.toFixed(4));
      praf = Math.abs(target.x - cur.x) + Math.abs(target.y - cur.y) > .001 ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : 0;
    };
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      target.x = e.clientX / window.innerWidth * 2 - 1;
      target.y = e.clientY / window.innerHeight * 2 - 1;
      if (!praf) praf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }, { passive: true });
  }

  /* ---------- Circuit lines on the dot grid ---------- */
  const canvas = section.querySelector('.bs-dev-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas && canvas.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx || reduceMotion) return;

  const GRID = 22, OFF = 11, COLORS = ['#2f6bff', '#5a4dff', '#8a3dff'];
  let w = 0, h = 0, cols = 0, rows = 0;
  const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
  const randInt = (a, b) => Math.floor(rand(a, b + 1));
  const pt = (c, r) => ({ x: OFF + GRID * c, y: OFF + GRID * r });

  const resize = () => {
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    w = canvas.clientWidth; h = canvas.clientHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr); canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    cols = Math.floor((w - OFF) / GRID); rows = Math.floor((h - OFF) / GRID);
  };
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);
  resize();

  const minX = () => isDesktop() ? (isOpen() ? .33 : .6) : 0;

  const makeTrace = () => {
    // Traces stay inside the dev panel: right of the slant normally, left of it in RTL (mirrored layout)
    const minCol = isRtl ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(cols * minX()) + 1);
    const maxCol = isRtl ? Math.max(1, Math.floor(cols * (1 - minX())) - 1) : cols - 1;
    const c0 = randInt(minCol, Math.max(minCol, maxCol)), r0 = randInt(1, rows - 1);
    const c1 = Math.max(minCol, Math.min(maxCol, c0 + randInt(4, 14) * (Math.random() < .5 ? -1 : 1)));
    const r1 = Math.max(1, Math.min(rows - 1, r0 + randInt(3, 9) * (Math.random() < .5 ? -1 : 1)));
    let pts;
    if (Math.random() < .5) {
      pts = [pt(c0, r0), pt(c1, r0), pt(c1, r1)];
    } else {
      const mid = Math.round((c0 + c1) / 2);
      pts = [pt(c0, r0), pt(mid, r0), pt(mid, r1), pt(c1, r1)];
    }
    const lens = pts.slice(1).map((p, i) => Math.hypot(p.x - pts[i].x, p.y - pts[i].y));
    return { pts, lens, total: lens.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), d: 0, fade: 1, arrived: false,
             color: COLORS[randInt(0, COLORS.length - 1)] };
  };

  const at = (t, dist) => {
    let d = Math.max(0, Math.min(dist, t.total));
    for (let i = 0; i < t.lens.length; i++) {
      if (d <= t.lens[i] || i === t.lens.length - 1) {
        const a = t.pts[i], b = t.pts[i + 1], k = t.lens[i] ? d / t.lens[i] : 0;
        return { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * k, y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * k };
      }
      d -= t.lens[i];
    }
    return t.pts[t.pts.length - 1];
  };

  const strokeRange = (t, from, to) => {
    const s = at(t, from);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
    let acc = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < t.lens.length; i++) {
      const end = acc + t.lens[i];
      if (end > from && acc < to) {
        const p = end <= to ? t.pts[i + 1] : at(t, to);
        ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      }
      acc = end;
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  };

  const traces = [];
  let raf = 0, last = 0, nextSpawn = 0;

  const frame = (now) => {
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    const dt = last ? Math.min(.05, (now - last) / 1000) : 0;
    last = now;

    if (now > nextSpawn && traces.length < 5 && cols > 2 && rows > 2) {
      traces.push(makeTrace());
      nextSpawn = now + rand(500, 1200);
    }

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    for (let i = traces.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = traces[i];
      if (t.arrived) {
        t.fade -= 1.2 * dt;
        if (t.fade <= 0) { traces.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      } else {
        t.d += 90 * dt;
        if (t.d >= t.total) t.arrived = true;
      }

      const head = at(t, t.d), a = .55 * t.fade;

      ctx.globalAlpha = .16 * a; ctx.strokeStyle = t.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      strokeRange(t, 0, t.d);

      const tail = at(t, t.d - 70);
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(tail.x, tail.y, head.x, head.y);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.addColorStop(1, t.color);
      ctx.globalAlpha = .8 * a; ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      strokeRange(t, t.d - 70, t.d);

      const s = t.pts[0];
      ctx.globalAlpha = .6 * a; ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

      if (t.arrived) {
        const e = t.pts[t.pts.length - 1];
        ctx.globalAlpha = .55 * t.fade; ctx.strokeStyle = t.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 2 + (1 - t.fade) * 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.globalAlpha = a; ctx.shadowColor = t.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  };

  new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting && !raf) { last = 0; raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
    else if (!entry.isIntersecting && raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
  }).observe(section);
})();
